transactions.counterparty: Frasers Property Limited (Sponsor) - via acquisition of 100% of North Gem Trust and its trustee-manager
transactions.citation: p8/p20: 'the purchase consideration' S$380.660m for 100% of North Gem Trust (equity + trustee-manager shares); agreed property value $1,133.0m = average of Colliers $1,146.0m and Savills $1,120.0m independent valuations as at 31 Dec 2024.
transactions.notes: Acquisition of 100% interest in North Gem Trust (private trust owning Northpoint City South Wing). Structured as an equity/unit purchase (S$380.660m purchase consideration for units + trustee-manager shares) rather than a direct property purchase, so purchase_price (equity consideration) is NOT on the same basis as the agreed property value (S$1,133.0m, 100% gross asset value) - gain_loss_pct is therefore NOT a meaningful discount/premium figure and is DERIVED here only for completeness of the schema, not as a comparable metric; treat with caution (equity consideration includes assumption of debt: gross investment-property value recognised on acquisition S$1,174,816k = equity consideration + assumed borrowings S$781,851k, FS Note 4). Total acquisition outlay approx S$393.238m incl. acquisition fee S$11.330m + transaction costs. Funded via April 2025 Equity Fund Raising. Seller is the Sponsor group (Frasers Property Limited); interested-person transaction.

transactions.counterparty: Lion (Singapore) Pte. Limited (wholly-owned subsidiary of Frasers Property Limited)
transactions.sale_price_citation: p9/p138/FS p199: 'On 23 September 2025, the Trust divested Y10 for a consideration of $34,500,000 to Lion (Singapore) Pte. Limited...'
transactions.citation: p9/p138/FS p199: 'On 23 September 2025, the Trust divested Y10 for a consideration of $34,500,000 to Lion (Singapore) Pte. Limited... with a net gain on divestment of $128,000.' Consideration negotiated as average of two independent valuations of $34.0m and $35.0m as at 31 May 2025. Investment-property movement note: 'Disposal (34,000)' (FY-end carrying value $34.0m).
transactions.notes: Divested to Lion (Singapore) Pte. Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of FPL (interested-person transaction). Gross consideration S$34,500,000. gain_loss_pct DERIVED vs_book_value = (34,500,000 - 34,000,000)/34,000,000 = +1.47% (net_sale_proceeds not separately disclosed, so gross sale_price used per the formula against carrying value). No premium/gain % explicitly disclosed by the AR. For reference, the AR's own disclosed net gain on divestment of $128,000 (net of transaction costs, FS Note 4) = +0.38% of carrying value - a smaller, cost-adjusted figure not used as primary since it is net of unspecified transaction costs (implied ~$372k) rather than the gross-consideration-vs-book comparison the SPEC calls for. Consideration was the average of two independent valuations of $34.0m and $35.0m as at 31 May 2025 (not the FY-end carrying value); if that average ($34.5m) were used as reference_basis=valuation instead, gain_loss_pct would be 0.00% by construction (consideration = valuation average), so book_value is the more informative basis and is used here. Net proceeds from divestment of investment property and investment in joint venture (Statement of Cash Flows) = $34,500,000 for FY2025 (no JV divestment that year, so the whole amount is Y10).
